_doc: Ragdoll lab scenarios (Prompt 01). Directions are in the man's own frame: -z is the way he faces, +x his right, +y up. 'push' is the argument handed to HumanBody.go_limp() (a blast's wind; until 2026-10-11 a bullet knockdown passed dir*1.2 and a blow dir*clamp(J/300,0.5,3): the *_shot_front and *_blow_front scenarios keep that old shove for comparison; *_ball ones are a shot as the game does it now, go_limp() and the ball's momentum on the part it hit). 'impulses' are the lab's own, applied after go_limp at a named segment and a point in that segment's rest-centred space, in N*s. 'pre' is what he does before he goes limp. Edit this file to add scenarios; no code change needed. 'dead': true kills him (a brain shot) as he goes limp: no tone, as the game gives a dead man. Since 2026-10-21: 'cause' (a blast through take_blast, a limb torn off through sever_limb, a blow through take_blow; he goes down only if it puts him down), 'drag' (hauled by the collar once down), 'later' (more impulses at t seconds after he went down), 'men' and 'spacing' (several men, man 0 logged), 'yaw' with the stairs and table fixtures (facing other ways), and the fixtures 'seat' and 'seat_table' with pre 'pose'. Groups M (the matrix) and N (blasts and blows, kept apart from shots). Group R (2026-10-21): a ball that doesn't drop him ('hit' with 'ball': true, through take_bullet, the knockdown roll off), standing, aiming ('gun': true) and walking: what the wound does to him (sheets with compare.py --from=hit). Group P (2026-10-21, Sean: 'falling down stairs and falling over railings and falling into tables and chairs and props'): the game's own stair (12 risers to the saloon balcony), its balcony rail, a porch edge and its steps, the hitching rail and the saloon's props (PropLibrary), the bar and crates; shot from behind, in front and the side, a faint, killed outright standing and running; 'focus_y' aims the cameras below a raised start. Group S (2026-10-21, Sean's staircase): the hotel's oak stair (art's OakStair, its own collision), from the top step, mid-flight facing down and up, over the walkway's railing (#172), at the foot, walking down; 'start' places him in the stair's space. Group O (2026-10-28, issue #479): the player's shove and kick (cause 'push', through HumanBody.take_push, numbers from ShoveTuning as PlayerShove works them out; 'wound' tears his right thigh first): on the open floor, wounded, at the saloon gallery's rail, a breakable rail, the hitching rail, a card table, a chair behind him, the bar, the saloon stair's top and middle, the oak stair's top and a porch edge, each pushed back (his +z) as a man facing you is; run each with --jitter=1..20 (experiments/kick_shove/run.py).
